title: Threshold — Free Bootstrap 6 Landing Page Template
excerpt: A free two-page Bootstrap 6 landing page whose sticky conversion bar shares its value with the hero form — so a half-typed email is never lost when you scroll.
yoastTitle: Threshold — Free Bootstrap 6 Landing Page Template
yoastDesc: Free Bootstrap 6 landing page template with a sticky signup bar that shares state with the hero form, a CSS-built product shot, comparison table, FAQ and a thank-you page with referral copy.
intro: Threshold is a free, premium Bootstrap 6 landing page template. One long page doing one job — hero, product shot, features, how it works, social proof, an honest comparison table, questions and a closer — plus a thank-you page with a queue position and a referral link.
note: A landing page puts an email field in the hero, another in the closer, and a third in a sticky bar — and in every template they are three unrelated inputs. So somebody types half an address, scrolls, and the sticky bar hands them an empty box. Here all three share one value: type anywhere and every copy has it. The sticky bar itself is honest too — it appears only once the hero form has genuinely left the viewport, and hides again over the closer, because a second call to action stacked on top of the real one is just clutter. Both use IntersectionObserver rather than a scroll handler, so nothing runs on frames where nothing changed. The product shot is a week grid built in CSS rather than a screenshot: sharp at any size, weighs nothing, and never dates.
summary: Threshold is a free, premium two-page Bootstrap 6 landing page template. The page runs a centred hero with the capture form and a calendar-week product shot built entirely in CSS, a logo band, four features, a three-step setup, three testimonials, a comparison table that stacks on mobile and concedes the honest column, a six-question FAQ on native details, and a closer. A sticky conversion bar appears once the hero form scrolls away and shares its value with it, so a part-typed address survives the scroll; it hides again over the closer to avoid stacking two calls to action. The thank-you page carries a queue position, a referral link with copy-to-clipboard that falls back on insecure origins, and something useful to do while waiting. Full light and dark mode, ESM-only vanilla JavaScript, no build step.
